content.short: Unifold provides cross-chain deposit infrastructure for prediction markets, exchanges and fintechs.
content.description: Unifold is deposit infrastructure for prediction markets, exchanges and fintech platforms, accepting any token on any chain and delivering the stablecoin the platform wants. A single API orchestrates deposits across Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin and others, with stablecoin payouts routed through whichever provider or partner offers the best path. Use cases include cross-chain margin deposits for perpetual venues and deposit rails for lending, staking and yield products. The company advertises setup in around nine minutes.
content.meta: Deposit infrastructure for prediction markets and exchanges, where funding friction costs revenue.
